disambiguation: Not a billing service; it tracks usage data locally from session files.
extras: No API key required. All calculations run locally on your device. Requires Node.js for certain setup scripts.
intentEvidence: Token Usage brings those insights directly into Obsidian, where many users already manage their projects, notes, and knowledge base.
motivation: To help users understand where tokens go for cost awareness and workflow optimization as Claude Code usage grows.
problem: Existing solutions often require API access or live outside the daily workflow, making local cost awareness difficult.
summary: Token Usage tracks Claude Code token consumption by reading local JSONL session files, providing real-time statistics, dashboards, and project breakdowns.
